## About
Rick Sprague Towing, Roadside & Mobile Mechanic Services is a locally owned and family operated business. We're committed to delivering expert, safe and affordable roadside and mobile mechanic service around Pittsburgh and the surrounding areas.
Our team brings years of combined towing, recovery, roadside and mechanic experience. Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 45 Google reviews, and they tend to mention Rick by name: a reviewer stranded on a Friday night with stripped bolts, and a family whose van broke down on Christmas Eve.

## Services
- Towing: Emergency towing within Pittsburgh and the surrounding areas.
- Battery Jump Starts: That clicking sound on a cold winter morning is never fun. Call and we'll come get you started.
- Vehicle Lockout Service: Keys lost, broken or locked inside, we'll send someone to help you get in and get back on your way.
- Tire Service: Blowout or slow leak, we'll send someone quickly to put on your inflated spare.
- Fuel Delivery Service: Out of gas? We bring enough fuel to get you to the nearest gas station, night or day.
- Mobile Mechanic Service: Broke down? Our mobile mechanic brings the repair to you.
- Brake Service: Brake work from our mobile mechanic team.
- Oil Change Service: Oil changes from our mobile mechanic team.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you cover?
A: All of the Pittsburgh areas, including Pittsburgh International Airport, plus the North Hills, South Hills, East Hills, West Hills and Washington County areas.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We take cash, Apple Pay, business checks, Visa, PayPal, American Express, Discover and Mastercard.

Q: I'm locked out of my car. What happens when I call?
A: We'll send someone out right away to help you get in and get back on your way.
